apps.localizedDescription:
Qaraq is an AniList client.

• My List with Watching, Rewatching, Completed, Paused, Planning, Dropped and custom lists
• Swipe gestures to bump progress or edit entries
• Explore and search anime and manga
• Activity feeds, notifications, favourites and stats
• Themes, accent colours and Liquid Glass on iOS 26
